source: Original Fuel Log recipes. Nutrition computed from USDA SR26 and FNDDS values in foods.json; salt and spices not counted.

recipes.name: Protein overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, yogurt, milk and chia seeds together in a jar.
Top with the blueberries and honey, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Eat cold, or warm it for a minute in the microwave.
recipes.tip: Make three jars on Sunday for an easy start to the week.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta egg scramble
steps: Warm the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and soften the pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Whisk the eggs and whites, pour them in, and stir gently until just set.
Sprinkle with feta and serve with the toast.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese berry bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the berries, walnuts and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana protein smoothie
ing: Ice and a pinch of cinnamon
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Add a splash more almond milk if it's too thick.

recipes.name: Freezer breakfast burritos
ing: 1 tsp chili powder and 1/2 tsp cumin
steps: Brown the turkey with the spices, then stir in the beans.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan until just set.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, eggs, cheese and salsa, and roll tightly.
Wrap each burrito in foil and freeze. Reheat for 2 minutes in the microwave (remove the foil first).
recipes.tip: Keeps 3 months in the freezer.

fz.how: Wrap each burrito in foil and freeze. Unwrap and microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Veggie egg muffin cups
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Divide the vegetables and cheese between the cups.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until set in the middle.
recipes.tip: One serving is 2 muffins. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

fz.how: Freeze on a tray, then bag. Microwave 60 to 90 seconds.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait
steps: Layer the yogurt, raspberries and granola in a glass.
Finish with the honey.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with eggs
steps: Toast the bread and mash the avocado on top with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Cook the eggs how you like them and lay one on each slice.
Finish with chili flakes.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl
ing: 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp each chili powder and cumin
steps: Rub the chicken with the spices and a pinch of salt, then grill or pan-cook 6 to 7 minutes a side.
Let it rest 5 minutes and slice.
Divide the rice, beans, corn and lettuce between 4 bowls.
Top with chicken, salsa, sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.tip: Packs well for 4 days of lunches. Add the avocado the day you eat it.

fz.how: Freeze the chicken, rice, beans and corn in containers. Add the lettuce, salsa and avocado after reheating.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt tuna wrap
ing: 1/4 cup diced celery and red onion
steps: Mix the tuna, yogurt, mustard, onion and celery with salt and pepper.
Lay the spinach on the tortilla, add the tuna salad, and roll it up.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa chickpea salad
steps: Whisk the oil and lemon juice with salt, pepper and a pinch of oregano.
Toss everything else together in a big bowl.
Pour over the dressing and toss again. It tastes better after an hour in the fridge.

recipes.name: Turkey and hummus pita
steps: Spread the hummus inside the pita.
Fill with turkey and vegetables.

recipes.name: Lighter chicken Caesar wrap
ing: 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp mustard, 1 garlic clove
steps: Whisk the yogurt, parmesan, lemon, mustard and grated garlic into a dressing.
Toss the romaine and chicken with the dressing.
Divide between the tortillas and roll up.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil and vegetable soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach and season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: Use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian. Freezes well.

fz.how: Cool, then freeze in portions. Reheat on the stove or microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon rice bowl
steps: Stir the soy sauce, honey, ginger and sesame oil together.
Brush half over the salmon and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.
Divide the rice, edamame and cucumber between bowls, add the salmon, and drizzle with the rest of the sauce.

recipes.name: High-protein egg salad
steps: Chop the eggs and mix with the yogurt, mustard, green onion, salt and pepper.
Serve on toast or in lettuce cups.

recipes.name: Black bean and veggie quesadilla
ing: 1 can black beans, rinsed and mashed
steps: Spread the beans over half of each tortilla and top with pepper, corn and cheese.
Fold and cook in a dry pan, 3 minutes a side, until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken and vegetables
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut in chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything with the oil and spices on a large sheet pan in one layer.
Roast 25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are browned.
recipes.tip: One pan, done. Leftovers make good lunches.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat in the oven or microwave. The vegetables soften a little.

recipes.name: Lean turkey chili
ing: 2 cans kidney or black beans, rinsed
2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil, then add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and spices for a minute.
Add the beans and tomatoes and simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with Greek yogurt instead of sour cream if you like.
recipes.tip: Freezes in portions for up to 3 months.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat from frozen on the stove, or thaw overnight and microwave.

recipes.name: Lemon garlic salmon with asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan, drizzle with oil, lemon and garlic, and season.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes. Serve with the quinoa.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
ing: 1 lb 90% lean ground beef or sliced flank steak
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and sesame oil with 2 tbsp water.
Brown the beef in a hot pan and set it aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water for 4 minutes.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce, and toss for a minute. Serve over rice.

fz.how: Freeze with the rice in portions. The broccoli softens a little after freezing.

recipes.name: Shrimp tacos with cabbage slaw
steps: Toss the shrimp with the spices and cook in a hot pan 2 minutes a side.
Mix the cabbage with the yogurt, half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas, fill with slaw, shrimp and avocado, and finish with lime and cilantro.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs with marinara and pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and Italian seasoning, and roll into 16 balls.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes.
Simmer the meatballs in the marinara for 5 minutes and serve over the pasta.

fz.how: Freeze the meatballs in sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Crispy tofu vegetable stir-fry
ing: 1 block extra-firm tofu (14 oz), pressed and cubed
1 cup snap peas or green beans
steps: Pan-fry the tofu in half the oil until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic, and toss until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Turkey and quinoa stuffed peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the tops off the peppers and scoop out the seeds.
Brown the turkey, then stir in the quinoa, tomatoes and seasoning.
Pack the filling into the peppers, cover with foil and bake 25 minutes.
Top with cheese and bake 5 more minutes uncovered.

fz.how: Freeze before the cheese goes on. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C) for 40 to 45 minutes, adding cheese at the end.

recipes.name: Herb pork tenderloin with roasted potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast 15 minutes.
Rub the pork with the rest of the oil and herbs, sear it on all sides, and add it to the pan with the green beans.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for a minute.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Serve over rice.
recipes.tip: Uses about half a can of regular coconut milk. Light coconut milk cuts the fat further.

fz.how: Freeze the curry in portions. Make rice fresh or freeze it separately.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
ing: 1/2 cup salsa and 1/2 cup Greek yogurt
steps: Toss the chicken with the seasoning.
Cook it in a hot pan with half the oil until browned, then set aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the rest of the oil until soft and charred at the edges.
Return the chicken, squeeze over lime, and serve in warm tortillas with salsa and yogurt.

fz.how: Freeze the chicken and pepper filling. Warm tortillas and add salsa and yogurt fresh.

recipes.name: No-bake peanut butter protein bites
steps: Stir everything together. Add a splash of milk if it's too dry to hold.
Roll into 24 balls and chill 30 minutes.
Keep in the fridge for up to a week.
recipes.tip: One serving is 2 bites.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 10 minutes, or eat straight from the freezer.

recipes.name: Hummus and veggie snack box
steps: Pack the hummus in a small container with the vegetables around it.

recipes.name: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple and dip or spread with peanut butter.

recipes.name: Homemade trail mix
steps: Mix everything and divide into 8 small bags or containers (about 1/4 cup each).
recipes.tip: Portion it out ahead of time. Trail mix is easy to overeat straight from the bag.

recipes.name: Ranch cottage cheese dip
ing: Dill, garlic powder, onion powder, lemon
steps: Blend the cottage cheese and yogurt until smooth.
Stir in the herbs and seasonings, and serve with vegetables.

recipes.name: Garlic chili edamame
steps: Cook the edamame according to the package.
Toss with sesame oil, garlic, chili flakes and salt.

recipes.name: Frozen berry yogurt bark
steps: Stir the honey into the yogurt and spread it 1/2 inch thick on a parchment-lined tray.
Scatter the berries and chocolate on top.
Freeze 3 hours, then break into pieces. Keep frozen.

fz.how: Keep it frozen. Eat straight from the freezer.

recipes.name: Tuna rice cakes
steps: Mix the tuna with the yogurt.
Spread on the rice cakes and top with cucumber and seasoning.

recipes.name: Blender protein pancakes
steps: Blend the oats, banana, eggs, cottage cheese, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook 1/4-cup scoops in a lightly oiled nonstick pan, about 2 minutes a side.
Serve with blueberries and maple syrup.

fz.how: Freeze flat with parchment between pancakes. Reheat in the toaster or microwave 45 seconds.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage egg muffin
steps: Toast the muffin.
Brown the sausage and fry the egg in the same pan.
Stack the egg, sausage and cheese on the muffin.
recipes.tip: Make five, wrap them in foil, and freeze for grab-and-go mornings.

fz.how: Wrap each sandwich in parchment and freeze. Microwave 90 seconds wrapped in a paper towel.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
steps: Warm the beans with half the salsa.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan and fry the eggs.
Top each pair of tortillas with beans, two eggs, the rest of the salsa, avocado and cheese.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with feta
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Make six wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter with feta and serve with warm pita.

recipes.name: Chocolate protein oatmeal
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the protein powder and cocoa.
Top with banana and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Berry smoothie bowl
steps: Blend the berries, yogurt and banana until thick. Add a splash of milk only if the blender stalls.
Pour into a bowl and top with granola and chia.

recipes.name: Mushroom and spinach omelet
steps: Cook the mushrooms and onion in the oil until soft, then wilt the spinach and set aside.
Pour the beaten eggs into the pan and cook until almost set.
Add the vegetables and cheese to one half, fold, and cook a minute more.

recipes.name: Savory cottage cheese toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with cottage cheese, top with tomato, and finish with seasoning and pepper.

recipes.name: Greek chicken couscous bowl
steps: Rub the chicken with oil, lemon, oregano and garlic, then grill or roast until cooked through.
Slice it and divide between bowls with the couscous and vegetables.
Top with feta and a spoonful of tzatziki.

recipes.name: Crunchy Asian chicken salad
ing: 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil and a little grated ginger.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, edamame and chicken with the dressing.
Top with peanuts, green onion and cilantro.
recipes.tip: Keep the peanuts separate if you're packing it for later so they stay crunchy.

recipes.name: Lighter Cobb salad
ing: 1/3 cup Greek yogurt ranch (yogurt, dill, garlic)
steps: Arrange the lettuce in two bowls and add rows of chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and tomato.
Stir the yogurt with dill, garlic powder and lemon for a quick ranch, and drizzle over.

recipes.name: Lemony tuna chickpea salad
steps: Toss everything together with salt and pepper.
Eat right away or keep it in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Turkey taco lettuce wraps
steps: Brown the turkey with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Spoon it into lettuce leaves and top with salsa, cheese and avocado.

fz.how: Freeze the seasoned turkey. Add the lettuce and toppings fresh.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, herbs and whole chicken breasts and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot, and stir in the cooked noodles.
recipes.tip: Cook the noodles separately if you're freezing it, so they don't go soft.

fz.how: Freeze the soup without the noodles. Add freshly cooked noodles when you reheat.

recipes.name: Pesto chicken panini
steps: Spread the pesto on the bread.
Layer the chicken, mozzarella, tomato and spinach.
Press in a hot pan or panini press for 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Smoky black bean soup
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the beans, salsa and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend about half the soup and stir it back in. Serve with a spoonful of yogurt.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat until steaming and add the yogurt after.

recipes.name: Shrimp and avocado salad
steps: Toss everything together with salt, pepper and a pinch of chili.
Serve right away, on its own or over greens.

recipes.name: Hummus and feta veggie wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Add the vegetables and feta and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Egg roll in a bowl
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic and ginger.
Add the cabbage and carrots and stir-fry until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil and top with green onion.
recipes.tip: All the flavor of an egg roll without the wrapper or the fryer.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Microwave 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon baked cod with potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the halved potatoes with half the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans and cod to the pan, drizzle with the rest of the oil, lemon and garlic.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes, until the fish flakes. Finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Lighter chicken tikka masala
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
Garam masala, cumin, turmeric, garlic, ginger
steps: Coat the chicken in the yogurt and half the spices and marinate at least 20 minutes.
Sear the chicken in the oil until browned, then set aside.
Cook the onion with the rest of the spices, add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then blend smooth.
Return the chicken, stir in the coconut milk, and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze the curry in portions with or without rice. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.name: Sirloin steak with sweet potato and broccoli
steps: Roast the cubed sweet potato and broccoli with the oil at 425°F (220°C) for 20 minutes.
Season the steak and sear it in a very hot pan, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain, and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.name: Lighter spaghetti bolognese
ing: 1 carrot and 1 celery stalk, finely diced
steps: Brown the beef, then add the onion, carrot and celery and cook 5 minutes.
Add the sauce and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan.
recipes.tip: The finely diced vegetables add volume and fiber without changing the taste much.

fz.how: Freeze the sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Kung pao-style chicken
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil until browned.
Add the peppers and zucchini and cook 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and chili and toss until glossy.
Top with peanuts and serve over rice.

fz.how: Freeze without the peanuts, with the rice in portions. Add the peanuts after reheating.

recipes.name: Pineapple teriyaki chicken
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
1 can pineapple chunks in juice, drained
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the chicken, pineapple and pepper with the teriyaki sauce on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes. Serve over rice with green onion.

fz.how: Freeze with the rice in portions. Microwave 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Herb tilapia with couscous
steps: Season the fish with dill, garlic, lemon, salt and pepper.
Cook it in half the oil, 3 minutes a side.
Sauté the zucchini and tomatoes in the rest of the oil and serve with the fish and couscous.

recipes.name: Greek turkey burgers
steps: Mix the turkey, feta, spinach, oregano and garlic and shape into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-cook 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Serve in warm pitas with tzatziki and vegetables.

fz.how: Freeze the cooked patties with parchment between them. Reheat in a pan or microwave. Add the tzatziki and vegetables fresh.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the lentils, sauce and 1 1/2 cups water and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Toss with the pasta and top with parmesan.

fz.how: Freeze the sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu noodles
steps: Pan-fry the cubed tofu in the sesame oil until crisp.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime and a few tablespoons of hot water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles, cabbage, carrots and tofu with the sauce.

recipes.name: Salsa verde pork bowls
steps: Cut the pork into 1-inch pieces and brown them in a little oil.
Add the salsa verde, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until tender, then shred.
Serve over rice with beans, corn, cilantro and lime.

fz.how: Freeze the shredded pork in its sauce. Reheat and serve over rice and beans.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp pasta with spinach
steps: Cook the garlic and chili in the oil for a minute, then add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes a side.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Toss with the pasta, lemon and parmesan, adding a splash of pasta water if it's dry.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage and veggie sheet pan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the halved potatoes with the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the sausage and vegetables, toss with the seasoning, and roast 15 to 20 minutes more.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat in a hot oven or skillet to crisp the potatoes back up.

recipes.name: Lean beef tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and salsa.

fz.how: Freeze the seasoned beef. Add the toppings fresh.

recipes.name: Red lentil dal
ing: Garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, garam masala
steps: Cook the onion in the oil until golden, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for a minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 4 cups water and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in the spinach and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add a splash of water when reheating, since it thickens.

recipes.name: Baked chicken parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan, and bake on a rack 15 minutes.
Spoon sauce over each piece, top with mozzarella, and bake 5 more minutes.
Serve with pasta and the rest of the sauce.

fz.how: Freeze the cooked chicken with sauce and cheese. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate protein pudding
steps: Stir everything together until smooth and thick.
Chill 10 minutes if you can, or eat right away.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the chickpeas very dry.
Toss with the oil and spices and roast 30 to 35 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crunchy.
Let them cool on the pan so they crisp up more.

recipes.name: 3-ingredient banana oat cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mash the bananas and stir in the oats, peanut butter and chocolate.
Scoop 12 cookies onto a lined tray and bake 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.tip: One serving is 2 cookies.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 15 minutes or warm 15 seconds.

recipes.name: Turkey and Swiss roll-ups
steps: Spread the turkey slices with mustard.
Lay a strip of cheese and a cucumber spear on each slice and roll up.

recipes.name: Parmesan popcorn
steps: Toss the warm popcorn with the oil, then the parmesan and a pinch of black pepper.
recipes.tip: Three cups of popcorn is a big bowl for under 150 calories.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with pineapple
steps: Spoon the pineapple over the cottage cheese.

recipes.name: Pumpkin pie protein yogurt
steps: Stir the pumpkin, maple and spice into the yogurt.
Top with granola.

recipes.name: Everything bagel eggs
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool in cold water, and peel.
Halve and sprinkle with seasoning. Serve with tomatoes.
recipes.tip: Boil a dozen at once. They keep a week in the fridge in their shells.

recipes.name: Chocolate date energy balls
steps: Pulse the almonds in a food processor until finely chopped.
Add the dates and cocoa and blend until it sticks together.
Roll into 16 balls and chill.
recipes.tip: One serving is 2 balls.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter chocolate banana bites
steps: Sandwich a little peanut butter between pairs of banana slices.
Dip halfway in melted chocolate and freeze on parchment for an hour.

fz.how: Keep them frozen. Eat straight from the freezer.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon oatmeal
steps: Bring the milk to a simmer in a small pot and stir in the oats, apple and cinnamon.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Top with walnuts and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Whole-wheat French toast with berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each slice of bread for a few seconds per side.
Cook in the buttered pan over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Serve with berries and maple syrup.

fz.how: Cool, then freeze flat. Reheat in the toaster or a 375°F (190°C) oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and turkey sausage hash
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the sweet potato, covered, 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the onion, pepper and sausage and cook uncovered 6 to 8 minutes until the potato is tender and browned.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3 to 4 minutes until the whites set.

recipes.name: Tofu scramble
ing: 1/2 tsp turmeric, garlic powder, salt, pepper
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 3 minutes.
Crumble in the tofu with your hands, add the turmeric and garlic powder, and cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season, and serve with toast.

recipes.name: Egg and black bean breakfast quesadilla
ing: 1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack, reduced fat
steps: Scramble the eggs until just set.
Lay the eggs, beans and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a dry pan, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until crisp and melted. Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Vanilla chia pudding
steps: Whisk the chia, almond milk, yogurt, maple and vanilla in a jar.
Stir again after 10 minutes so the seeds don't clump, then refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with berries.

recipes.name: Bircher muesli
steps: Stir the oats, grated apple, yogurt, milk and raisins together.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with almonds in the morning. Thin with a splash of milk if it's too thick.

recipes.name: Ham, spinach and cheese egg bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Spread the bread, ham, spinach and half the cheese in the dish.
Whisk the eggs and milk with salt and pepper, pour over, and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes, until set in the center and golden.
recipes.tip: Assemble it the night before and bake in the morning.

fz.how: Freeze cooled squares wrapped individually. Microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek salad with chicken
ing: 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, oregano
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper and olives.
Dress with the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Top with sliced chicken and feta.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla soup
ing: 4 corn tortillas, cut in strips and baked
steps: Soften the onion, jalapeño and garlic in the oil, then stir in the spices.
Add the broth, tomatoes and whole chicken breasts and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it with the beans and corn, and simmer 5 minutes.
Bake the tortilla strips at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Serve the soup topped with strips, avocado and lime.

fz.how: Freeze the soup without the tortilla strips and avocado.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt chicken salad sandwich
steps: Mix the chicken, yogurt, celery, grapes, mustard and a squeeze of lemon. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon onto the bread with lettuce.

recipes.name: French lentil salad
ing: 1 cup dry green or brown lentils
2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water 20 to 25 minutes until tender but not mushy. Drain.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard with salt and pepper and toss with the warm lentils.
Add the vegetables, parsley and feta. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Tuna Niçoise salad
ing: 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon
steps: Boil the halved potatoes 12 to 15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain and cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard into a dressing.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, eggs, olives and tuna on plates and drizzle with dressing.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes, then add the garlic and seasoning.
Add the zucchini, tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the beans, cooked pasta and greens and simmer 5 minutes more. Serve with parmesan.
recipes.tip: Keep the pasta separate if you're making it ahead, so it doesn't soak up all the broth.

fz.how: Freeze without the pasta. Add freshly cooked pasta when you reheat.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki pitas
ing: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, oregano, garlic
steps: Marinate the chicken in the oil, lemon, oregano and garlic for at least 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or broil 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato, onion and lettuce.

recipes.name: Chef salad
steps: Slice the turkey, ham and cheese into strips and quarter the eggs.
Arrange over the lettuce with the tomatoes and cucumber.
Stir dill, garlic powder and lemon into the yogurt for a quick ranch and drizzle over.

recipes.name: Pasta e fagioli
ing: 2 cups cooked ditalini or small pasta
steps: Brown the beef, then add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, beans and herbs. Simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta just before serving.

fz.how: Freeze without the pasta. Add freshly cooked pasta when you reheat.

recipes.name: Everyday chicken curry
ing: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, then add the chicken and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until cooked through.
Take off the heat and stir in the yogurt. Serve with rice and cilantro.

fz.how: Freeze the curry in portions. Reheat gently and stir in a little yogurt after.

recipes.name: Oven tandoori-style chicken
ing: Garlic, ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon, oil, garlic, ginger, spices and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Arrange the chicken on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through (165°F / 74°C). Serve with cucumber and lemon.

recipes.name: Chana masala
ing: 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 green chili
2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp turmeric
steps: Cook the onion in the oil until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili and spices and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, then the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon and cilantro and serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Make rice fresh or freeze it separately.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi (potato and cauliflower)
ing: Garlic, ginger, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp garam masala, chili
steps: Heat the oil, add the cumin seeds until they sizzle, then the onion. Cook 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and ground spices, then the tomatoes, and cook 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower, 1/4 cup water and salt. Cover and cook on low 15 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Finish with garam masala and cilantro.

recipes.name: Keema matar (spiced ground turkey and peas)
ing: Garlic, ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, chili
steps: Cook the onion in the oil until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices, then the turkey, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then the peas for 5 more. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze in portions with or without the rice.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
ing: Garlic, ginger, green chili, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garam masala
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, cool, and blend smooth.
Cook the onion in the oil until golden, then add the garlic, ginger, chili, spices and tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and simmer 5 minutes, then add the paneer and warm through.
Take off the heat, stir in the yogurt, and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Rajma (kidney bean curry)
ing: Garlic, ginger, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp garam masala, chili
steps: Cook the onion in the oil until deep golden, about 12 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomatoes. Cook until thick, about 8 minutes.
Add the beans and 1 cup water and simmer 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add a splash of water when reheating.

recipes.name: Chicken piccata
steps: Season the chicken and dust lightly with flour.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat, 3 minutes a side, until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Add the broth, lemon juice and capers to the pan and simmer 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the chicken to warm through and serve over spaghetti with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken cacciatore
steps: Brown the seasoned chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms in the same pan 6 to 8 minutes, then add the garlic and herbs.
Add the tomatoes and return the chicken. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes until tender.
Serve over pasta.

fz.how: Freeze the chicken and sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Baked eggplant parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Dip the eggplant in egg, then in breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan.
Bake on oiled sheet pans 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Lower the oven to 375°F (190°C). Layer sauce, eggplant and mozzarella in a 9x13-inch dish, finishing with sauce, mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C), covered, for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Pasta primavera
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli and peas for the last 2 minutes. Save 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Sauté the zucchini, pepper and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Toss everything with the parmesan, lemon zest and enough pasta water to make it glossy. Finish with basil.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage with peppers and onions
ing: 4 whole-wheat hoagie rolls or 2 cups cooked pasta
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil, about 8 minutes, then slice.
Cook the peppers and onions in the same pan 10 to 12 minutes until soft.
Return the sausage, add the marinara, and simmer 5 minutes. Serve on rolls or over pasta.

fz.how: Freeze the sausage, peppers and sauce. Serve on fresh rolls or pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken fried rice
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil until cooked, then set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the pan and set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, then the peas and carrots and garlic for 2 minutes, then the cold rice. Fry 3 to 4 minutes without stirring too much.
Return the chicken and egg, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions, and toss.
recipes.tip: Day-old rice works best. Freshly cooked rice turns mushy.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Microwave 3 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.name: Thai basil chicken (pad krapow)
ing: 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp oil, 4 garlic cloves, 2 Thai chilies
steps: Stir-fry the garlic and chilies in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add the onion and pepper for 2 minutes, then the sauces and sugar.
Stir in the basil until wilted and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken lettuce wraps
ing: 1 can water chestnuts, diced (optional, not counted)
steps: Cook the chicken with the garlic and ginger, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the mushrooms and water chestnuts and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the hoisin, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Korean-style ground beef bowl
ing: Garlic, ginger, green onion, sesame seeds
steps: Brown the beef with the garlic and ginger and drain any fat.
Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil and simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with broccoli, cucumber, green onion and sesame seeds.

fz.how: Freeze the beef with the rice. Add the cucumber fresh.

recipes.name: Baked sesame chicken
ing: 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, garlic, ginger
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and bake on a lined sheet pan 15 to 18 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger 2 minutes until slightly thick.
Toss the chicken in the sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve with rice and broccoli.

recipes.name: Cashew chicken stir-fry
ing: 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp hoisin
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry the snap peas and pepper 3 minutes with the garlic and ginger.
Return the chicken, add the sauces, and toss for a minute. Stir in the cashews and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vegetable lo mein
ing: 8 oz lo mein or spaghetti, cooked
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp hoisin
steps: Stir-fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat 4 minutes.
Add the cabbage, carrots, bok choy, garlic and ginger and cook 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauces and toss until coated. Finish with sesame oil and green onion.

recipes.name: Miso-glazed salmon with bok choy
steps: Heat the broiler. Stir the miso, honey and soy sauce together and brush over the salmon.
Broil 7 to 9 minutes, 6 inches from the heat, until the glaze is browned and the fish flakes.
Sauté the bok choy in the sesame oil 3 to 4 minutes. Serve with the salmon and rice.

recipes.name: Pork chops with apples and onions
steps: Season the chops and sear in the oil 4 to 5 minutes a side until they reach 145°F (63°C). Rest on a plate.
Cook the apples and onion in the same pan 6 to 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the broth, mustard and thyme and simmer 2 minutes, scraping up the browned bits. Spoon over the chops and serve with steamed green beans.

recipes.name: Slow cooker pulled pork
ing: Paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt, pepper
8 whole-wheat buns or 4 cups coleslaw mix
steps: Rub the pork all over with the spices.
Put the onion in the slow cooker, add the pork and broth, and cook on low 8 hours (or high 5 to 6) until it shreds easily.
Shred the pork, discard the fat, and toss with the barbecue sauce and some of the cooking juices. Serve on buns or over slaw.
recipes.tip: The numbers don't include buns. A whole-wheat bun adds about 200 cal.

fz.how: Freeze the sauced pork in portions. Reheat covered so it doesn't dry out.

recipes.name: Pork carnitas
ing: 3 lb boneless pork shoulder, in 2-inch chunks
4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, salt
steps: Put the pork, juices, onion, garlic, spices and 1 cup water in a heavy pot. Simmer covered 2 hours until very tender.
Uncover and cook until the liquid evaporates and the pork starts to fry in its own fat, about 20 minutes. Shred.
For crisp edges, spread on a sheet pan and broil 3 to 5 minutes. Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, cilantro and onion.

fz.how: Freeze the shredded pork with some of the juices. Crisp it in a hot pan after thawing.

recipes.name: Pork and green bean stir-fry
steps: Stir-fry the pork in half the oil over high heat 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked. Set aside.
Stir-fry the green beans in the rest of the oil with 2 tbsp water, covered, 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili, pork and sauces and toss for a minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Classic beef stew
ing: 2 lb beef chuck, cubed and trimmed
steps: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper and brown it in batches in the oil.
Add the onion, celery and garlic for 3 minutes, then the tomato paste, broth, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer gently 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer 30 to 40 minutes more, until the beef and vegetables are tender.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. The potatoes soften a little but hold up well.

recipes.name: Lean shepherd's pie
ing: 1 cup low-sodium broth, 1 tbsp flour, 1 tbsp tomato paste
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes until tender and mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Brown the beef with the onion, stir in the flour and tomato paste, then the broth, thyme and Worcestershire. Simmer 5 minutes and add the vegetables.
Spread in a 9x13-inch dish, top with the potatoes, and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

fz.how: Freeze in portions or the whole dish. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C), covered, for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.name: Lean meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix the beef, oats, egg, onion, milk and seasonings gently and shape into a loaf on a lined pan.
Stir the ketchup and brown sugar together and spread over the top.
Bake 55 to 60 minutes, until it reaches 160°F (71°C). Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

fz.how: Freeze cooled slices. Reheat covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.name: Lighter beef stroganoff
steps: Sear the beef in the oil over high heat 1 to 2 minutes and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms 6 to 8 minutes, stir in the flour, then the broth and mustard. Simmer 3 minutes until thick.
Take off the heat, stir in the yogurt (off the heat so it doesn't split) and the beef. Serve over noodles with parsley.

recipes.name: Beef and barley soup
ing: 3/4 cup pearl barley, cooked to 2 1/4 cups
steps: Brown the beef in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms 8 minutes, then add the garlic.
Return the beef with the broth, herbs and uncooked barley. Simmer covered 1 hour until the beef and barley are tender.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add a little broth when reheating, since the barley thickens it.

recipes.name: Steak fajita bowls
steps: Rub the steak with the spices and sear in a very hot pan 4 to 5 minutes a side for medium. Rest 5 minutes and slice thinly against the grain.
Cook the peppers and onion in the oil until charred and soft.
Build bowls with rice, beans, vegetables, steak and salsa, and finish with lime.

fz.how: Freeze the steak, vegetables, rice and beans. Add salsa after reheating.

recipes.name: Black bean burgers
ing: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and patted dry
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Spread the beans on a sheet pan and bake 10 minutes to dry them out.
Mash the beans, leaving some texture, and mix in the oats, egg, pepper, onion and spices. Shape into 4 patties.
Brown in the oil 4 to 5 minutes a side. Serve on buns with lettuce, tomato and salsa.

fz.how: Freeze cooked or uncooked patties with parchment between them. Cook or reheat from frozen in a pan.

recipes.name: Three-bean vegetarian chili
ing: 2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, garlic, oregano
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and zucchini in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the beans, tomatoes, corn and 1 cup water. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes until thick.
Serve topped with cheddar.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add the cheese after reheating.

recipes.name: Vegetable frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In an oven-safe skillet, cook the zucchini and pepper in the oil 5 minutes, then wilt the spinach.
Whisk the eggs and milk with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables, and scatter the cheese on top.
Cook on the stove 3 minutes until the edges set, then bake 12 to 15 minutes until the center is just firm.

recipes.name: Ratatouille with white beans
steps: Cook the eggplant in half the oil 8 minutes until browned, then set aside.
Cook the onion, peppers and zucchini in the rest of the oil 8 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme.
Add the tomatoes, eggplant and beans and simmer 20 minutes until everything is tender. Finish with basil and parmesan.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add the parmesan after reheating.

recipes.name: Black bean stuffed sweet potatoes
ing: 1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack, reduced fat
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Prick the sweet potatoes and bake 45 to 50 minutes until soft.
Warm the beans and corn with the salsa and cumin.
Split the potatoes, fill with the beans, top with cheese, and return to the oven 5 minutes. Finish with yogurt, cilantro and lime.

fz.how: Freeze the filled potatoes before the yogurt goes on. Reheat at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked falafel bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and flour in a food processor until it holds together but isn't a paste.
Shape into 20 small patties, brush with the oil, and bake 25 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.
Serve over couscous with cucumber, tomato and tahini thinned with lemon and water.

fz.how: Freeze the baked falafel. Reheat at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes to crisp them.

recipes.name: Roasted chickpea Buddha bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with the oil and spices and roast 25 minutes.
Massage the kale with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon until soft.
Build bowls with quinoa, kale, the roasted sweet potato and chickpeas, and avocado. Drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon juice and water.

recipes.name: Mushroom and spinach whole-wheat pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and save 1 cup of the water.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil over high heat 8 minutes without stirring too much. Add the garlic and chili for a minute.
Add the spinach, pasta, ricotta, parmesan and enough pasta water to make a creamy sauce. Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Baked cod fish tacos
ing: Chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, cilantro
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush the cod with oil, season with the spices, and bake 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes.
Mix the yogurt with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Flake the fish into warm tortillas and top with cabbage, avocado, the lime yogurt and cilantro.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Stir-fry the vegetables in the oil 4 minutes over high heat.
Add the garlic, ginger and shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes until pink.
Add the soy sauce and honey and toss. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan salmon with potatoes and broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the potatoes with half the oil 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli and salmon, drizzle with the rest of the oil, and season with garlic, dill, salt and pepper.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes. Squeeze lemon over everything.

recipes.name: Guacamole with veggie sticks
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt.
Stir in the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeño.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

recipes.name: Tzatziki with cucumber and pita
ing: 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice, dill
steps: Mix the yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, lemon, dill, oil and a pinch of salt.
Chill 15 minutes if you can. Serve with cucumber slices and pita.

recipes.name: Classic homemade hummus
ing: 3 tbsp ice water, 1/2 tsp cumin, salt
steps: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for a minute until creamy.
Add the garlic, cumin, salt and chickpeas and blend, adding the ice water a spoonful at a time, until very smooth.
Finish with a drizzle of the olive oil.
recipes.tip: One serving is 1/4 cup. Serve with vegetables or a few whole-wheat pita wedges.

recipes.name: Ants on a log
steps: Fill the celery with peanut butter and dot with raisins.

recipes.name: Baked kale chips
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
Tear the kale into pieces, dry it well, and massage with the oil and salt.
Spread in a single layer and bake 15 to 20 minutes until crisp but not brown. Sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.name: Fruit salad with honey-lime yogurt
steps: Cut the fruit into bite-size pieces and toss together.
Stir the honey and lime into the yogurt and spoon over the fruit.

recipes.name: Mango lassi
steps: Blend everything until smooth and frothy.

recipes.name: Green protein smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Cinnamon baked apples
ing: 1/2 cup nonfat Greek yogurt, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix the oats, walnuts, maple, melted butter and cinnamon and pack into the cored apples.
Set in a baking dish with 1/2 cup water and bake 30 to 35 minutes until tender. Serve with a spoonful of yogurt.

recipes.name: Peanut butter yogurt dip with apples
steps: Stir the yogurt, peanut butter and honey until smooth.
Serve with apple slices.
